req.title: PUT /players/{id} requires body
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when PUT /players/{playerId} is called without a request body.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-038 requires that PUT /players/{playerId} returns HTTP 422 when called without a request body. The actual endpoint in the source is PUT /players/squadnumber/{squad_number}. Three test cases are designed: (1) NEG — send PUT with no body at all to a known squad number, expect 422; (2) EP positive — send PUT with a valid body to a known squad number, expect 204 (confirming the route works when body is present, so the 422 is body-absence-specific); (3) BVA — send PUT with an empty JSON object body ({}), which is missing required fields, expect 422. These cover the error pathway (422), the happy path (204), and the boundary between empty-object and no-body. Exact status code assertions (== 422, == 204) are used throughout to catch comparison-operator mutations. The endpoint path uses squad_number as the natural key per the source.

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_put_player_no_body_returns_422():
    response = client.put('/players/squadnumber/10')
    assert response.status_code == 422

test_put_player_no_body_returns_422()

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_put_player_valid_body_returns_204():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Kabir",
        "middleName": "Mary",
        "lastName": "Reddy",
        "dateOfBirth": "1910-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 10,
        "position": "Right Winger",
        "abbrPosition": "DM",
        "team": "River Plate",
        "league": "Ligue 1",
        "starting11": False
    }
    response = client.put('/players/squadnumber/10', json=payload)
    assert response.status_code == 204

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_put_player_no_body_response_contains_detail():
    response = client.put('/players/squadnumber/1')
    assert response.status_code == 422
    body = response.json()
    assert 'detail' in body
    assert isinstance(body['detail'], list)
    assert len(body['detail']) > 0

tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_put_player_partial_body_missing_required_fields_returns_422():
    partial_payload = {
        "middleName": "Test",
        "dateOfBirth": "1905-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
        "starting11": True
    }
    response = client.put('/players/squadnumber/5', json=partial_payload)
    assert response.status_code == 422
    body = response.json()
    assert 'detail' in body
